customCommands.name: manifold-audit
customCommands.description: Audit code for manifold compliance — no facades, no forbidden patterns
customCommands.prompt:
Audit the following code for Manifold compliance. Check for:
1. Forbidden patterns: JSON serialization in manifold layer, iterating dimensions, flat CRUD
2. Facades: Maps/objects wearing manifold labels without genuine PathExpression/RepresentationTable
3. Missing delta caching
4. Encode/decode chirality violations (encode === decode)
5. Straight-line shortcuts that bypass geodesic traversal

Grade each section A-F. Fix all F-grades.

customCommands.prompt:

- Replace all key lookups with PathExpression z-invocation
- Add delta caching where state is stored
- Ensure encode (write) and decode (read) are chiral — never the same operation
- Follow the 7-section helix: Void→Point→Line→Width→Plane→Volume→Whole
- Zero forbidden patterns
